set.body: Deliver a connected abstract-token workflow that constructs one reusable rich source, groups declared rows into scenes through a checked public API with explicit row-ID remap, builds multiple recalls, runs structural candidates and recorded direct mapping separately, fills conditional graded fidelity, and saves the three analysis views. Discriminate repeated cast/different actions, actor swaps, changed attributes, joint/broad/alternative/external references, reorder and revisit without collapsing occurrence IDs. Scripted replies test contracts, not provider accuracy. Scene grouping must be source-only, preserve graph/evidence and exact support gaps, refuse duplicate/foreign/already-parented rows and expose changed IDs. Full narrative hierarchy, event/episode targets and semantic channels remain owed. Verify installed public API/CLI, source immutability and independent readback; meaningful negative controls and cold review.
set.title: P3 recurring-cast correspondence with checked source scene grouping
